data.body:
Planning-only Acceptance Criteria heading remediation complete.

Updated exactly eight descriptions by replacing the single line `## Acceptance` with `## Acceptance Criteria`: `autositic-relaxative-nurseshark`, `dizzy-muscovite-drever`, `necessary-subtle-cooter`, `unable-wingless-bustard`, `florid-gelatinous-doe`, `polyhedral-overbrutal-norwayrat`, `inferior-mystical-arrowworm`, and `orange-typical-orca`.

Final MCP readback confirmed all eight descriptions match the prepared pre-edit text byte-for-byte except for that nine-character suffix. Each has one new heading and no old heading. All eight remain open. Every file-impact array and verify-command array is unchanged. MCP `check_ac` passed 8 of 8 with five criteria lines on each ticket.

Initial MCP transport or commit failures were read back before fallback. The repo-venv fallback writes were not visible on the configured MCP tracker, so the seven affected descriptions were retried through MCP and persisted with `push_status=ok`. No LLM gate, claim, source edit, test, transition, commit, or code push was performed.
